d.x: Kenyatta was recognized at the time of his death in mid-1978 as Mzee, "the wise old one," not only by his own people but by a wide array of world leaders.

mzee.e: Etymology tree Swahili -zee Swahili mzeebor. English mzee Borrowed from Swahili mzee, from -zee (“old”).

d.x: I have given my daughter to an mzungu, and he says he will make her like the wives of the white men.

mzungu.e: Etymology tree Common Bantu *mʊ̀díʊ́ngʊ̀der. Swahili mzungubor. English mzungu Borrowed from Swahili mzungu, from Common Bantu *mʊ̀díʊ́ngʊ̀.
